events.title: Nightly Wallet introduced publicly
events.description: Nightly's first-party 2022-07-04 introduction presented Nightly Wallet as the first part of the Nightly ecosystem and described its multichain wallet functionality. The source says the extension was live in the Chrome Web Store but not yet public, so this record is an announcement/introduction event and does not infer the later public launch date.
